versions.changelog:
Initial release of context7-mcp skill:

- Provides up-to-date library, framework, and API documentation for user questions.
- Supports setup, configuration, code generation, and reference queries for popular frameworks (like React, Next.js, Prisma, Supabase, etc.).
- Guides on resolving the library ID and fetching scoped documentation for accurate answers.
- Recommends splitting multi-topic queries and prioritizing official sources and version-specific docs when available.
- Ensures inclusion of current code examples and relevant version citations in responses.
